g.text: Set your stats by arranging the bonuses 3, 2, 2, 1, and 1 across them in any order. A move adds one stat to the action
die, so put the 3 where your character is strongest.
Quickness, agility, and prowess in ranged combat
Courage, willpower, empathy, sociability, and loyalty
Physical strength, endurance, aggressiveness, and prowess in close combat
Up and down choose a stat · 1-3 set its bonus · Enter next · Esc back · Ctrl+Q quit
